caption:
Tsukiji Fish Market in Tokyo! 

Everything I ate for breakfast this day and WOWOWOW do I miss it!!! If you plan on visiting Japan the Tsukiji market is a MUST !!! 

#japantravel #tsukijifishmarket #tsukijimarket #tsukiji #tokyo #tokyofood #japanesefood #japaneats".
transcription: Here is everything I ate at the Sukiji Fish Market in Tokyo, Japan. We got there at 9 a.m. and this was our first bite and the best bite of the entire trip, which was melt in your mouth, Wagyu. The best steak I've ever had in my life. Up next I have this. I have no idea what it was. But it was really good. It was warm. It was crunchy. I had kimchi on top of it and inside there was like a warm gravy of sorts. We got a strawberry smoothie and then we headed over for some fresh scallops. I've never had scallops like this and I love them so much. I'm obsessed with pork buns. like this is one of my favorite favorite things so I had to get two of them they were so cheap, so pillowy soft I could have 8 probably 10. Please look at the color of the sushi. I have never had fresher more melt in your mouth sushi than I've had in Japan especially at this market. We ended our time here with another Wagyu skuer. This was like a thinner Wagyu cut. It was still so incredible. The following morning we actually came back to get another Wagyu skuer because it was that good and then we tried the katsu and the sashimi at the food court in the market.

caption:
Top 10 bites from Kyoto!!!! 🏯🍜🥟

#kyoto #kyotofood #japanfood #foodreview #japanitinerary".
transcription: These are the toughest things I had on my trip to Kyoto. Kyoto was full of good eats, so let's get into it. At number 10 are these mochi balls from Totaro. Came with brown sugar and ice cream or with a matcha sauce. They were so chewy and the brown sugar was so good. Number 9 are these chicken and pork caught two sandwiches. We just needed something quick, so this was a pretty chill meal. They were pretty good though. At number 8 is the matcha from Go-Ka Go-Ka. I think that's how you say it. Honestly, super creamy. Then we have this chestnut ice cream. I love chestnut and the flavor was spot on. Okay, so this is Kyoto's famous dessert. Basically mochi stuff with the paste or jian. They're most famous when it's strawberry. One store on Giants Street was just giving away free samples, so I was just in lunching. Literally tried every flavor that was so good. Next is the viral Muffichirma soup from Matchahouse. Although the name was a bit misleading because there was no coffee flavor, it was still so good. I was in complainant because I don't like coffee. The creamiest filling aber with a cake underneath. Then we have these fluffy pancakes. That's the caramel one and the caramel had like this burnt and bitter alphate taste to it, which was a nice time. This ramen shop is run by two sisters and it was so popular in my feed. However, I don't think the broth was that good, but guys, the pork was insane. Never had pork like that in my life, so if you go make sure to order like three sides of it and not alone It's worth the way for some of the best kiosa in your life had to chow chow kiosa We have all types of kiosa and it's perfect And they also have really interesting flavors like plum and mashed potatoes Oh, and they have chocolate kiosa, but make sure to get the kiko brisala. It was so good And a number one is a temporary shop I've already talked about the shop loads of time so you guys know my thoughts. It's amazing. You have to go know ifs or buts
